== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Mecha Knight}}
{{Intents Table/row

|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (25;{{Asc2|9|30}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row

|Intent = Attack4, StatusCard
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|12}}) damage. Adds 4 {{C2|Burn}} to your hand.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Windup
|Intent = Defend, Buff
|Effect = Gains 15 {{KW2|Block}} and 5 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block, Strength

{{Intents Table/row

}}

Starts with {{Int2|Mecha Knight|Charge}} and then repeats this cycle for the rest of combat:
* {{Int2|Mecha Knight|Flamethrower}}
* {{Int2|Mecha Knight|Windup}}
* {{Int2|Mecha Knight|Heavy Cleave}}
